queries.name: M3-multiplicity

queries.name: M4-cohort
queries.sql: SELECT now()-interval '30 days' window_start,now() window_end,count(*)::int rows,count(*) FILTER(WHERE "syncStatus"='SUCCESS')::int success_rows,count(*) FILTER(WHERE "syncStatus"='SUCCESS' AND COALESCE("errorMessage",'') ILIKE '%empty patch%')::int success_empty_patch_message,count(*) FILTER(WHERE "syncStatus"='SUCCESS' AND "payload"::text ILIKE '%empty patch%')::int success_empty_patch_payload FROM "OutboundSyncQueue" WHERE "targetChannel"='AMAZON' AND "syncType"='STATUS_UPDATE' AND "createdAt">=now()-interval '30 days'

queries.name: M4-success-shapes

queries.name: M4-cohort-payload-keys
queries.sql: SELECT k.key,count(*)::int rows FROM "OutboundSyncQueue" q CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_object_keys(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(payload)='object' THEN payload ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) k(key) WHERE "targetChannel"='AMAZON' AND "syncType"='STATUS_UPDATE' AND "syncStatus"='SUCCESS' AND "createdAt">=now()-interval '30 days' GROUP BY k.key ORDER BY k.key

queries.sql: SELECT c.relname index_name,i.indisunique,i.indisvalid,i.indnullsnotdistinct,pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid) definition FROM pg_index i JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=i.indexrelid WHERE i.indrelid='"ChannelListing"'::regclass AND i.indisunique ORDER BY c.relname

rows.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "ChannelListing_pkey" ON public."ChannelListing" USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "ChannelListing_productId_channelMarket_akey_key" ON public."ChannelListing" USING btree ("productId", "channelMarket", "channelConnectionId", "aliasKey") NULLS NOT DISTINCT
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "ChannelListing_productId_channelMarket_conn_key" ON public."ChannelListing" USING btree ("productId", "channelMarket", "channelConnectionId") NULLS NOT DISTINCT

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "ChannelListing_productId_channel_marketplace_akey_key" ON public."ChannelListing" USING btree ("productId", channel, marketplace, "channelConnectionId", "aliasKey") NULLS NOT DISTINCT
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "ChannelListing_productId_channel_marketplace_conn_key" ON public."ChannelListing" USING btree ("productId", channel, marketplace, "channelConnectionId") NULLS NOT DISTINCT

queries.name: multiplicity
queries.sql: SELECT "productId",channel,marketplace,count(*)::int rows,jsonb_agg(DISTINCT jsonb_build_object('channelConnectionId',"channelConnectionId",'aliasKey',"aliasKey",'aliasId',"aliasId")) shapes FROM "ChannelListing" GROUP BY "productId",channel,marketplace HAVING count(*)>1 ORDER BY channel,marketplace,"productId"

queries.name: control
queries.sql: SELECT current_user role,current_setting('nexus.workspace_id',true) workspace_setting,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM "Product") products,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM "ChannelListing") listings
